name: seis-focus-navigation-audit
description: Audit bounded local UI source for static keyboard, focus, semantic-control, and reduced-motion evidence without launching a browser.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect static keyboard, focus, and motion evidence in local UI source.
interface.longDescription: Audits bounded local HTML, JavaScript, and CSS source for static keyboard, focus, semantic-control, ARIA, and reduced-motion evidence. It never launches a browser, drives a screen reader, or certifies runtime accessibility compliance.
defaultPrompt: Audit this local SEIS UI source for static keyboard, focus, semantic-control, and reduced-motion evidence without launching a browser.
Show static focus-navigation findings and the manual accessibility evidence still required before release.
